trusts.name: National Highways Infra Trust (NHIT)
trusts.note: NHAI's flagship InvIT — the government's road-monetisation vehicle. Concessions run 20–30 years.

trusts.name: Raajmarg Infra Investment Trust (RIIT)
trusts.assets: 5 toll roads · 260.2 km · Jharkhand, AP, TN, Karnataka (Golden Quadrilateral sections)
trusts.note: NHAI's second (and first public-IPO) InvIT — Chennai Bypass, Chennai–Tada, Chilakaluripet–Vijayawada, Gorhar–Barwa Adda, Neelmangla–Tumkur.

trusts.name: PowerGrid Infrastructure Investment Trust (PGInvIT)
trusts.assets: 5 inter-state transmission SPVs (~3,699 ckm lines, 11 substations)
trusts.note: Only listed power-transmission InvIT. Availability-based revenues (no traffic risk) — bond-like cash flows, ~12.9% trailing yield.
